feature: gRPC automatic HTTP CONNECT proxy policy

scope.endpoint: TLS host endpoints for ordinary Channel and SharedChannel
scope.configuration: explicit endpoint proxy, policy override, injected environment map, or explicit Zig process-environment snapshot
scope.transport: HTTP/1.1 CONNECT followed by authenticated TLS with mandatory h2 ALPN
scope.ownership: ChannelTlsHostProxyTarget owns canonical URI and generated credentials for the complete channel lifetime

observed_contract: explicit channel proxy value precedes grpc_proxy, https_proxy, and http_proxy
a present empty proxy value disables proxying and suppresses lower-priority sources
only the http URI scheme is supported and URI userinfo becomes RFC 7617 Basic proxy authorization
no_grpc_proxy precedes no_proxy even when explicitly empty
bypass entries support exact and boundary-aware subdomain matching plus IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR
Unix and VSock targets do not pass through the name proxy mapper

implementation.pure_policy: ChannelProxyPolicy.resolve consumes a borrowed ChannelProxyEnvironment without reading mutable process-global state
implementation.real_environment: initEnviron snapshots std.process.Init.minimal.environ through Zig 0.16 std.process.Environ.createMap
implementation.precedence: explicit endpoint proxy > policy explicit_uri > grpc_proxy > https_proxy > http_proxy
implementation.empty_semantics: a selected empty explicit or environment value returns an observable empty_proxy direct decision
implementation.bypass: no_grpc_proxy > no_proxy; ASCII whitespace, empty entries, optional leading dot, case-insensitive exact/subdomain boundaries, IPv4 CIDR, and IPv6 CIDR are covered
implementation.credentials: strict percent decoding and Basic encoding occur once; credentials are removed from the canonical proxy URI and replace only prior Proxy-Authorization headers
implementation.observability: direct decisions distinguish disabled, not_configured, empty_proxy, and bypassed while proxy decisions expose the winning source
implementation.failure_semantics: invalid URI, unsupported scheme, invalid host, and malformed percent escapes fail configuration instead of silently connecting directly
implementation.scope_safety: the owning factory accepts only TLS host endpoint configuration; address, Unix, VSock, and custom connectors are not implicitly remapped
implementation.identity: optional tunnel_authority changes only CONNECT routing; origin SNI, certificate verification, :authority, deadline, retry, and picker identity stay origin-bound

advantages_over_reference: deterministic injected environment view for exhaustive and race-free tests
explicit configuration errors prevent accidental direct egress after malformed proxy configuration
owned lifetime wrapper prevents generated URI or authorization slices from expiring beneath a Channel
structured source and direct-reason telemetry is available without parsing logs
one explicit process-environment boundary supports Zig applications without hidden global access
native_cases: all proxy-source precedence levels and explicit empty suppression
real process-environment snapshot with proxying disabled
percent-decoded username and password including encoded at-sign and colon
credential URI sanitization and Proxy-Authorization replacement while retaining other CONNECT headers
malformed percent escape, unsupported scheme, invalid URI, and invalid proxy host rejection
case-insensitive domain, exact domain, subdomain boundary, leading-dot, empty-entry, and whitespace bypass
no_grpc_proxy presence suppressing a matching no_proxy value
IPv4 /8, /16, /24, /32 and /0 behavior plus invalid prefix rejection
ordinary Channel and SharedChannel RPCs through an automatically selected proxy
exact CONNECT authority and Basic authentication with absence from origin HPACK metadata
explicit endpoint proxy taking precedence without evaluating invalid automatic settings

process_case.environment: real grpc_proxy with userinfo plus conflicting https_proxy, http_proxy, no_grpc_proxy, and no_proxy values
assertions: grpc_proxy wins over lower-priority proxy variables
present non-matching no_grpc_proxy suppresses matching no_proxy
userinfo generates the exact Basic credential required by Hyper
CONNECT authority is the independent localhost dynamic route
TLS identity remains foo.test.google.fr with certificate verification and h2 ALPN
two canonical UnaryCall RPCs reuse one tunneled HTTP/2 connection
